raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_transactions.amount values carry a literal '$' prefix (e.g. '$75.13', seen from batch 12 onward), which breaks the DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions. Every amount is USD and the '$' is only a display prefix, so stripping it before the cast yields the intended value without changing the grain or output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
